question: 分级为 PG-13 的电影有多少部?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM film WHERE rtng = 'PG-13'

question: 每位演员出演过多少部电影?只返回名、姓、出演数三列,按出演数降序、名升序、姓升序取前 10。
gold_sql: SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm, COUNT(fa.ref2) AS n FROM actr a JOIN flm_act fa ON a.actr_id = fa.ref1 GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm ORDER BY n DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

question: 每位客户的总消费金额是多少?只返回名、姓、金额三列,按金额降序、名升序、姓升序取前 10。
gold_sql: SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, SUM(p.amt) AS total FROM pymt p JOIN card cd ON p.ref1 = cd.card_id JOIN cust c ON cd.ref1 = c.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm ORDER BY total DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

question: 客户 MARY SMITH 一共租过多少部不同的电影?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.flm_id) AS n FROM cust c JOIN rntl r ON c.cust_id = r.ref2 JOIN invt i ON r.ref1 = i.invt_id JOIN film f ON i.ref1 = f.flm_id WHERE c.frst_nm = 'MARY' AND c.last_nm = 'SMITH'

question: 喜剧(Comedy)分类下一共有多少部电影?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM film f JOIN flm_cat fc ON f.flm_id = fc.ref1 JOIN catg c ON fc.ref2 = c.catg_id WHERE c.nm = 'Comedy'

question: 电影 ACADEMY DINOSAUR 有哪些演员?只返回名、姓两列,按名升序、姓升序。
gold_sql: SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm FROM film f JOIN flm_act fa ON f.flm_id = fa.ref2 JOIN actr a ON fa.ref1 = a.actr_id WHERE f.ttl = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR' ORDER BY a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC

question: 可以租借 7 天的电影有多少部?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM film WHERE rnt_dur = 7

question: 目前活跃的客户有多少位?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust WHERE actv = 1

question: 消费总额超过 150 元的客户有多少位?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT cd.ref1 FROM pymt p JOIN card cd ON p.ref1 = cd.card_id GROUP BY cd.ref1 HAVING SUM(p.amt) > 150) t

question: pymt 表里一共有多少个不同的付款方?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref1) AS n FROM pymt

question: pymt 表里一共有多少个不同的经办人?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref2) AS n FROM pymt

question: rntl 表里一共有多少个不同的租借方?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref2) AS n FROM rntl

question: rntl 表里一共有多少个不同的经办人?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref3) AS n FROM rntl

question: cust 表里一共有多少个不同的归属网点?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref1) AS n FROM cust

question: awd 表里一共有多少个不同的获奖出演者?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ref1) AS n FROM awd

question: 获奖最多的 3 位演员分别是谁?只返回名、姓、获奖数三列,按获奖数降序、名升序、姓升序。
gold_sql: SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm, COUNT(*) AS n FROM awd w JOIN actr a ON w.ref1 = a.actr_id GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm ORDER BY n DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC LIMIT 3

question: 用虚拟卡付款的客户有多少位?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cd.ref1) AS n FROM pymt p JOIN card cd ON p.ref1 = cd.card_id WHERE cd.crd_typ = '虚拟卡'

question: 用封卡(blocked)状态付款的客户有多少位?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cd.ref1) AS n FROM pymt p JOIN card cd ON p.ref1 = cd.card_id WHERE cd.sts = 'blocked'

question: 每位客户用过的付款卡数量是多少?只返回名、姓、卡数三列,按卡数降序、名升序、姓升序取前 10。
gold_sql: SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT cd.card_id) AS n FROM pymt p JOIN card cd ON p.ref1 = cd.card_id JOIN cust c ON cd.ref1 = c.cust_id GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm ORDER BY n DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

question: 每位客户拥有的付款卡数量是多少?只返回名、姓、卡数三列,按卡数降序、名升序、姓升序取前 10。
gold_sql: SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, COUNT(cd.card_id) AS n FROM cust c JOIN card cd ON c.cust_id = cd.ref1 GROUP BY c.cust_id, c.frst_nm, c.last_nm ORDER BY n DESC, c.frst_nm ASC, c.last_nm ASC LIMIT 10

question: 有多少位客户拥有超过一张付款卡?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT ref1 FROM card GROUP BY ref1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) t

question: 有多少张付款卡处于封卡(blocked)状态?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM card WHERE sts = 'blocked'

question: 消费总额最高的客户,住在哪个城市?只返回城市名一列。
gold_sql: SELECT ci.cty FROM cust c JOIN addr a ON c.ref2 = a.addr_id JOIN city ci ON a.ref1 = ci.cty_id WHERE c.cust_id = (SELECT cd.ref1 FROM pymt p JOIN card cd ON p.ref1 = cd.card_id GROUP BY cd.ref1 ORDER BY SUM(p.amt) DESC LIMIT 1)

question: 有多少张付款卡从未被任何付款使用过?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM card WHERE card_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ref1 FROM pymt)

question: doc 表覆盖的电影,总片长是多少分钟?只返回一个数值。
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.lngth) FROM doc d JOIN film f ON d.doc_id = f.flm_id
